query_analysis.original_query: Our liquid-liquid extractor shows oscillations in flow rates between stages. Could this be related to pump controls or system instability?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and diagnose the root causes of oscillations in flow rates between stages in a liquid-liquid extractor, focusing on potential issues related to pump controls and system instability.

selected_agents.role: Identify root causes of flow oscillations
Analyze pump controls and system stability

communication_strategy.information_flow: Exchange of diagnostic findings and control system analysis
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated troubleshooting combining control dynamics and equipment performance

clarification_questions: When did the oscillations in flow rates first occur?
Have there been recent changes to pump control settings or operating conditions?
Are there any other anomalies observed in the process parameters?
